findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Your Style. Your Cut. Your Standard." → 3 lines (6 words, 84px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 9 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 8 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "GOOD CUTS. GOOD COMPANY." above "Your Style. Your Cut. Your Standard."; "THE LOOKBOOK" above "Find your next look."; "THE MENU" above "A good cut. Done properly."; "THE FINISHING TOUCH" above "Good tools. Better routines."; "GOOD PEOPLE. GOOD HANDS." above "Meet the people behind the chair."
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "03", "04", "05", "06"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 53 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "INDEPENDENT BARBERS · MANILA", "DEMO PROTOTYPE SAMPLE DETAILS", "GOOD CUTS. GOOD COMPANY.", "SHARP WORK. NO SHORTCUTS.").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): div.map-grid → linear-gradient(30deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 47%, rgba(201, 193, 169, 0.11) 48%, rgba(201, 193, 169, 0.11) 49%, rgb
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 1 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.map-center-pin → rgba(196, 165, 109, 0.13) 0px 0px 0px 10px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 31 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.site-header 1440px | section#home.hero 1440px | div.gallery-bottom 1220px | div.service-list 1220px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 14 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 2 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (7, 3 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (section #e9e6dc, text #e9e6dc).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: Unreadable text: "Done properly." 1.5:1 (#d4bb88 on #e9e6dc); "behind the chair." 1.5:1 (#d4bb88 on #e9e6dc)
findings.fix: Raise contrast to at least 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large display.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 10px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (5.8:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 133 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: Little motion: 9 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Give every section an entrance for its parts (not one fade of the whole block) and add one moving picture: a looping clip or a slow move on a photograph.
